spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (अंशयति)
To separate or divide. See अंस.

m. (-शः)
1 A share or portion.
2 A part.
3 A shoulder, the shoulder blade.
4 (In arithmetic) a fraction.
5 The numerator of a fraction.
6 A degree of latitude or longitude, &c. See अंस.
E.
अंश to divide, अच् affix.

r. 10th cl. (अंसयति)
To separate of divide; also written अंश.

m. (-सः)
1 A shoulder, a scapula.
2 A part, a portion.
E.
अंस to divide, अच् aff. it is also written अंश.

m. (-कः)
A kinsman, a relation, a coheir.
n. (-कं)
a day.
E.
अंश to separate or divide, and वुन् affix.

mfn. (भाक्)
An heir, a coheir, one who has a share or portion.
E.
अंश and भाज् who possesses.

n. (-नं)
Dividing, sharing.
E.
अंश and युच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be divided, divisible.
E.
अंश and अनीयर aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Dividing, sharing.
E.
अंश and शानच् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यती-यत्)
Dividing, sharing.
E.
अंश and यति affix.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Divisible, to be divided.
E.
अंश and तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ता-ची-तृ)
Dividing, sharing.
E.
अंश and शतृ aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Strong, stout, lusty. See अंसस्न.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Strong, stout, lusty.
E.
अंस the shoulder, and लच् aff. also written अंशल.

mfn. (-रः रा-री-रं)
A sharer, a divider, a coheir.
E.
अंश and हर who takes.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
A sharer, a coheir.
E.
अंश and हारिन् who takes.

m. (-शः)
Part of a portion or share.
E.
अंश repeated.

ind.
Share by share.
E.
अंश repeated and इ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Divided, portioned, shared.
E.
अंश and क्त aff.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
A sharer, a coheir.
E.
अंश and इनि poss. aff.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
Divisible, to be shared or divided.
E.
अश and यत् aff.

m. (-शुः)
1 A ray of light, a sun-beam.
2 Light, splendor, effulgence.
3 Dress, decoration.
4 A small filament or end of thread.
5 The sun.
6 A minute particle or atom.
E.
अंश to divide, कु aff.

n. (-कं)
1 Fine cloth, muslin.
2 A mantle, a wrapper, a robe, a linen garment worn round the upper part of the body.
3 Cloth in general.
4 White cloth.
5 A leaf.
E.
अंश and कन् added.

n. (-लं)
1 A collection or blaze of light.
2 A parcel or pencil of rays.
E.
अंशु and जाल a net.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
अंशु and धर who holds.

m. (-र्त्ता)
The sun.
E.
अंश and भर्तृ lord.

mfn.(-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Radiant, luminous.
2 Acuminated, pointed.
m. (-मान्)
1 The sun.
2 A prince of the solar race, son of ASAMAÑJAS, grandson of SĀGARA.
(-ती)
A plant, (Hedysarum Gangeticum.)
E.
अंशु and मतुप् poss. aff.

f. (-ला)
The plantain, (Musa paradisiaca.)
E.
अंशुमत् and फल fruit.

f. (-ला)
A garland of light, a halo.
E.
अंशु and माला a garland.

m. (-ली)
The sun.
E.
अंशुमाला and इनि aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Radiant, splendid.
E.
अंशु and लच् aff.

m. (-णः)
The sun.
E.
अंशु and वाण an arrow.

m. (-स्तः)
The sun.
E.
अंशु and हस्त the hand.

m. (-टः)
A bull's hump, the protuberance between the shoulders of the Indian ox.
E.
अंस the shoulder, and कूट a peak.
